{{Quote|She may not look like much, but she'll get off the ground.|''[[New Hope]]'' Deck Master describes the ''Crow''|audio=MayNotLookLikeMuch-DFSftE.flac|<ref name="SftE audio drama">[[Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire (audio drama)|''Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire'' audio drama]]</ref>}}
The '''''Moldy Crow''''' was a [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] [[HWK-290 light freighter/Legends|HWK-290 light freighter]] that was used by [[Kyle Katarn]] and [[Jan Ors]] on their missions. It was later replaced by the ''[[Raven's Claw]]''.

==Description==
[[File:Kyleincockpit.jpg|thumb|left|220px|Inside the cockpit of the ''Moldy Crow''.]]
The ''Moldy Crow'' was a modified HWK-290 light freighter and [[Transport/Legends|transport]]. By its tenth year of service, it looked badly hit, as if the hull was barraged by [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]]; its bow was also much scarred, after multiple [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmospheric]] entries. Along its both sides, the name ''Moldy Crow'' was painted. Despite these, it enjoyed a recent overhauling of its drives, its [[Deflector shield/Legends|shield]] operated almost at one hundred percent, and [[Kyle Katarn]] equipped it with a reconditioned [[Navigation computer/Legends|navcomp]].<ref name="SFTE">''[[Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire]]''</ref>

Its security systems included external rivet-size [[Camera/Legends|microcameras]].<ref name="SFTE" /> The emergency bypass switch skipped normal safety procedures, and the nav computer took exception to the breach protocol.<ref name="JK" /> In cases of haste, the faster start-up sequence brought the drives online, which in turn brought up the navigation, weapons, and [[Life support/Legends|life-support]] systems.<ref name="SFTE" /> 

The ''Crow'' was quite fast and heavily armed, relative to other ships of its size.<ref name="JK" />

==History==
[[File:Moldy_Crow_-_XW_MG.jpg|thumb|right|220px|''Moldy Crow'' flies over [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]]]
The ''Moldy Crow'' was built circa [[10 BBY/Legends|10 BBY]]. It was part of the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation's]] Hawk series of [[Transport/Legends|transports]].<ref name="DFS 2" /> Its original role was delivering small shipment between [[asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] [[mining/Legends|mines]] and orbital [[Space_station/Legends|stations]].<ref name="JK">''[[Dark Forces: Jedi Knight]]''</ref>

===First owners===
One of the ship's earliest owners was the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Roark Garnet/Legends|Roark Garnet]], who used it until he inherited the ''[[Dorion Discus]]'' from his dead sister, [[Neena Garnet|Neena]]. He used the ''Crow'' as payment for debts incurred to [[Grappa (Hutt)|Grappa the Hutt]].<ref name="DFS 2" />

It was eventually stolen from Grappa by [[Dace Bonearm]] and [[IG-72/Legends|IG-72]]. The two [[bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] were after the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] bounty on [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] commander [[Winfrid Dagore]], and used the ship as a decoy to capture her, before dumping it on the planet [[Teth/Legends|Teth]]. The abandoned ''Crow'' then fell into the hands of Lieutenant [[Palob Godalhi/Legends|Palob Godalhi]], who gave up the beat-up freighter to the Rebel [[Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser/Legends|Dreadnaught]] ''[[New Hope]]''.<ref name="DFS 2" />

===Use under Kyle Katarn===
{{Quote|You've got to be joking. This isn't even a ship! Hey, I thought you said this thing would get off the ground!''"<br />"''It will. But after that, I'm not making any promises.|Kyle Katarn to the deck master at his first sighting of the ''Crow''|audio=MoldyCrowFirstLook-DFSftE.flac|<ref name="SftE audio drama" />}}
[[File:MoldyCrow_2017_Quarter3TournamentKit_ElitePrizeCard.png|thumb|left|180px|The ''Moldy Crow'' destroys a pair of TIE fighters.]]
In the hands of the Rebels, the ten years-old ''Crow'' stayed in the [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] bay of the ''New Hope''. Although its external appearance looked much abused, its engines had an overhauling and its last maintainers kept her logbooks up to date.<ref name="SFTE" />

[[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] assigned it to [[Kyle Katarn]], along with a [[gig]] and a slouching [[Courier/Legends|courier]] ship, and after performing several lengthy checks on their weapons, defenses, engines and systems, the ''Crow'' proved better conditioned than either. Preparing for the [[Mission to Danuta]], he spent several [[Standard day/Legends|days]] complementing it with several pieces of equipment, from a new navcomp and parts, to tools and commodities. Rebel experts forged documentation so that it appeared as a civilian freighter delivering high priority spares from [[Drog VI]] for the [[Brodsport Mining Corporation]] on [[Danuta]].<ref name="SFTE" />

====Mission to Danuta====
The trip took five days, mostly piloted by the navcomp; and arriving at the planet, the ''Crow'' was approached by two patrolling [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIEs]], and Katarn stated his identity to [[X-Ray 291]], before landing the ''Crow'' on the [[Trid spaceport]]. Katarn spent his first day on Danuta in recon and while the ''Crow'' stayed in the spaceport, three times common thieves approached and tried to break in; their unsuccessful attempts were caught on video by the ''Crow''{{'s}} rivet-size [[Camera/Legends|microcameras]] wired to its security system. Kyle returned to have his dinner and sleep.<ref name="SFTE" />

The next day he arranged with [[Jan Ors]] to pilot it herself and land on the top of the [[Danuta research facility]] in order to pick him up with the [[Death Star plans/Legends|Death Star plans]]. In the meantime the customs agent and some [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtroopers]] had realised that something was not right with the Drexel character who was using the ship right when Jan was attempting to board it. The ramp retracted as they ran towards her, and while the emergency start-up sequence was coming online, the soldiers started shooting, although their bolts were useless against the ''Crow''{{'s}} [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]]. Jan lifted it off and swung it, and fired the belly gun against then, then headed for the nearby TIEs parked in the spaceport, in order to have less pursuit on their way out. She raised the ''Crow'' for three meters and shot at the [[TIE pilot]]s running towards their ships. One managed to lift off one TIE while the ''Crow'' needed time to stabilize. While the TIE pilot missed his shot, Jan's detonated the enemy vessel, and proceeded with the other pursuit craft, before heading west to the research complex.<ref name="SFTE" /> The same patrolcraft that contacted "Dan Drexel" earlier, X-Ray 291, ordered the ''Crow'' to reverse and circled around the ship shooting, but the TIE was also shot down by the belly cannon.<ref name="SftE audio drama" />

Around that time a makeshift bomb planted by Ors had detonated at the northern perimeter of the complex, attracting the attention of some Imperial forces and the ''Crow'' exited a ravine, locking on an [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|AT-ST]]; the ''Crow'' received some hits but soon the walker's command module exploded, and the legs fell on a scout car, while Ors concentrated against the command car before [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Horst]] had time to order a retreat.<ref name="SFTE" /> The ''Crow'' arrived on the rooftop courtyard some time after Kyle reached it holding the memory matrix with the Death Star plans, and covered him with cannon fire against his pursuers, as he hurled himself onto the ramp. The ''Crow'' left Danuta's atmosphere in hypersonic speed, and returned to the Rebel base.<ref name="SFTE" /><ref name="Dark Forces">''[[Star Wars: Dark Forces]]''</ref>

====The Dark Trooper Project====
Despite his initial reservations for the ship, Kyle would grow attached to it during his career as a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]], and one reason would be its name: he also considered himself a bird estranged from his flock.<ref name="SFTE" /> While the ship was registered and belonged to Katarn, it was Ors who piloted it most of the time, being a better pilot.<ref name="JK" /><ref name="DFS 2" />

He would utilize it later in his mission to discover and then destroy the [[Dark Trooper Project]]. More often than not, though, it was Ors, Kyle's partner and mission coordinator, who piloted the ship for pick-up and drop-off. The ''Crow'' travelled to [[Talay/Legends|Talay]] after some [[Attack on Tak Base|massacre]], where it left Katarn near [[Tak Base]], to discover the existence of the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]]. Following the leads, the ''Crow'' travelled to [[Anoat/Legends|Anoat]] where Katarn captured [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Rebus (Galactic Empire)|Rebus]] for interrogation by the Alliance. Further investigation led the ''Crow'' to [[Fest/Legends|Fest]], [[Gromas/Legends|Gromas]], [[Orinackra]], [[Cal-Seti/Legends|Cal-Seti]] and [[Anteevy/Legends|Anteevy]].<ref name="Dark Forces" />

[[File:Mission_to_Nar_Shaddaa.png|thumb|right|220px|The ''Crow'' over Nar Shaddaa]]
The ship travelled to [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] to disrupt [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] operations and discover the location of the ''[[Arc Hammer]]''; however as they lifted from the Smuggler's Moon, the ''Crow'' was near-immediately snared in the [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beams]] of the luxury [[Yacht/Legends|yacht]] [[Star Jewel/Legends|''Star Jewel'']], the personal craft of the crime lord [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the]] [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]. As it turned out, it was Jabba's smugglers that had been helping the Empire make the necessary trips to deliver the materials that the Dark Trooper Project needed across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Ors was held captive and Katarn was almost executed if it weren't for his fighting and combating skills, who eventually retrieved his gear, rescued Ors and the pair found their way back to the ''Crow''. Then they went to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] where Ors was involved in an orbital skirmish against TIEs, before finally dropping Kyle off to [[Fuel Station Ergo/Legends|Ergo]].<ref name="Dark Forces" />

====New Republic====
{{Quote|You know, just once I'd like to board this ship without half the Empire on my tail.|Kyle Katarn|<ref name="RAAD" />}}
The pair continued to work for the rest of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|civil war]]. 
[[File:CrowdockedwithMercy.jpg|thumb|left|220px|The ''Moldy Crow'' docked with ''Mercy''.]]
Sometime after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] Katarn left the Rebellion to return to Nar Shaddaa for some unspecified errand, and Ors traveled there with the ''Crow'' to find him. Kyle had fell on a platform with a [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE bomber]] of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] about to shoot at him if not for Ors's firing. Kyle refused to board and they agreed to meet again at the top after he finished his task. Katarn did not respond to the radio and Ors moved towards the flashes of light and explosions, the ''Crow''{{'s}} sensors showing a commotion of various beings. The bounty hunters who turned around when they heard the ship approaching, attempted to shoot their blasters but the ''Crow'' evaded them and swung firing the cannon, killing them. Ors dragged Kyle unconscious up the ramp. In the trip back to Rebel space Katarn's health fluctuated, with Ors trying to find help in the ship's limited medical references. Three [[Standard day/Legends|days]] later they reached the [[Hospital ship/Legends|hospital ship]] ''[[Mercy (hospital ship)|Mercy]]''.<ref name="RA">''[[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent]]''</ref><ref name="RAAD" /> After Katarn recovered, the ship had to stay at some repair bay for several days and Jan had to stay behind when Katarn [[Mission to Sulon|left for]] [[Sulon/Legends|Sulon]];<ref name="DF2">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]''</ref> once the repairs were complete, they met there.<ref name="RAAD" />

====Sulon====
On Sulon, the ''Crow'' once again saved Kyle's life as he was escaping from [[Katarn estate|his old farmlands]] along a highway in a [[T-4 (vehicle)|T-4]]. Se saw him fighting a gang of [[Grave Tuskens]] while running straight towards a barricade. She lowered the ''Crow'' and started to extend the ramp, and immediately a droid grabbed Kyle and lifted both of them inside the ship. That was moments before the T-4 impacted the barricade resulting in an explosion that killed both Tuskens and Imperials. It turned out that Kyle brought with him not only his family droid [[WeeGee]], but also a [[Qu Rahn's lightsaber|lightsaber]] and some important knowledge about the [[Map to the Valley of the Jedi]], although it was too late for it.<ref name="RA" />

The ''Crow'' then was kept hidden as Katarn tried to sneak into [[Barons Hed]] and infiltrate [[Jerec (Inquisitor)|Jerec's]] [[Government House (Sulon)|Dark Tower]]. There however he was unable to catch 8t88 or bring the Map; Jan landed on the pad of the Tower's roof, evading some battery shots; once Kyle was safe, it flew after 8t88's shuttle, towards [[Fuel City]].<ref name="RA" /><ref name="DF2" /> There it made a stop near station six, where ''[[Sulon Star]]'' was parked, causing [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Zyak]] to scold Jan, who apologised politely. All this was just to allow enough time for Kyle to drop, after which, and Zyak's threats, she throttled away.<ref name="RAAD">[[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent (audio drama)|''Dark Forces: Rebel Agent'' audio drama]]</ref>

[[File:CrowExplosion.jpg|thumb|right|220px|The ''Crow'' fleeing from the [[Fuel City]].]]
The ''Crow'' hid in a hollow, but when it was time again to pick up Kyle, it rose up, surprising a local [[farmer/Legends|farmer]] who lost control of his [[hoversled/Legends|gravsled]]; flying low, it skimmed a hilltop and scattered a flock of [[gra]]. As usual, the ship arrived in the midst of [[lightfight]] between Kyle and Stormtroopers, and Zyak was trying to handle the situation. Jan ignored his orders to leave, and Zyak realised that the ship was responsible for the infiltration and the ensuing chaos. Jan detected four incoming [[heat-seeking missile/Legends|heat-seeking missiles]], and responded with [[Chaff/Legends|chaff]], four [[antimissile missile]]s, and finally destroyed a [[storage tank sixteen|storage tank]] in order to distract any remaining missiles. This caused a chain reaction and tank after tank blew up in succession. The ''Crow'' flew among the control tower, fiery pillars and a communications pylon, before approaching the ''Sulon Star'', and Kyle jumped on the open ramp. As TIEs started to emerge, Kyle suggested to retreat to the [[Nefra Canyons]].<ref name="RA" /><ref name="RAAD" />

Jan led the pursuit far from the City, she piloted the ship between "the twins", two narrow peaks of the [[Hanto Mountains]] where a TIE crashed, before diving into a big ravine of the Canyons, pulling the remaining TIE there. Kyle emerged from the top hatch and tried to shoot the pursuer with [[Bryar_pistol/Legends|his blaster]]; using [[the Force/Legends|the Force]], he managed some hits on the pilot's [[transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]] [[viewport/Legends|viewport]], right before the ''Crow'' evaded a cliff wall, on which the TIE crashed.<ref name="RA" /><ref name="RAAD" /> 

Soon after they parked the ''Crow'' in an abandoned factory while worked to obtain the map to Ruusan from 8t88's memories; they were visited by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]],<ref name="RA" /> and followed him back to the ''New Hope''.

====Milagro====
{{Quote|The ''Moldy Crow'', huh? I thought I was the only one allowed to fly cargo freighters in the battle."<br />"Well, the Alliance cannot afford to be choosy."<br />"No kidding. Why do you think they made me a General?|Han Solo and Kyle Katarn|<ref name="JK audio">[[Dark Forces: Jedi Knight (audio drama)|''Dark Forces: Jedi Knight'' audio drama]]</ref>}}
[[File:Second_Battle_of_Milagro.jpg|thumb|left|220px|Jan Ors [[Starfighter_combat/Legends|dogfights]] against [[Purdy M. Trico|Trico]]'s TIEs alongside Skywalker's X-wing.]]
Folowing Luke's [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]], they [[hyperspace/Legends|hyperspaced]] to the [[Milagro system/Legends|Milagro system]] where the ''New Hope'' was, just right when the flagship was under attack; it happened that the two ships exited hyperspace just near the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] and its escort, revealing thus its location for [[General/Legends|General]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]. The ''Crow'' then participated in the [[battle in the Milagro system]]. Luke and Kyle persuaded Jan to engage the Destroyer's fighters in order to buy time for reinforments, and break into the defensive screens in order to avoid fire. Imperial Captain [[Purdy M. Trico]] was frustrated that he could not destroy the two ships, and resolved to breaking formation so that his [[gunner/Legends|gunners]] get a better shot. This allowed for the ''[[Millennium Falcon/Legends|Millennium Falcon]]'', followed by the [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red]],<ref name="JK audio" /> [[Blue Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Blue]] and "[[Medpac Squadron]]" to engage the Destroyer directly.<ref name="JK" />

Thanks to Trico's mistake and the combined efforts of the ships, the Destroyer announced its surrender and it was captured along with its escort ships. In the aftermath, Katarn expressed to Mon Mothma his intention to continue pursuing Jerec even without her support. Mothma wondered how the ''Crow'' would pass through Jerec's [[Vengeance Battle Group|blockade]] above Ruusan, and it was decided that the ''Crow'' could be stowed inside a [[transport/Legends|transport]] carrying supplies to the Imperials. The ''[[High Hauler]]'' was chosen and the ''Crow'' was parked in her launch bay. According to the cover story, the freighter was a cheap replacement of a lost Imperial shuttle. The ''Hauler'', pilet by [[Alfonso Luiz Obota]], reached the [[Ruusan system/Legends|Hoth's Brand system]] and an hour later it was boarded by an inspection party from the ''[[Vengeance (Vengeance-class)|Vengeance]]'', it's [[assault shuttle/Legends|assault shuttle]] parked next to the ''Crow''; Ors, who was the only woman of the strike force, and would seem odd in the Imperial military, remained hidden in the cockpit and tried to monitor the Imperial communications with a rigged comm set. It was only after the inspection when [[Unidentified Imperial lieutenant (Ruusan)|the Imperial Lieutenant]] noticed the freighter, surprising the Rebel agent who expected a question about it later; nonetheless, the Officer was satisfied with the explanation.<ref name="JK" /> Obota asked permission for some supply runs for the ''Crow'', and the Lieutenant offered to clear its [[transponder signal/Legends|transponder signal]] with flight control on the ''Vengeance''.<ref name="JK audio" />

[[File:Youhavebeentricked.jpg|thumb|right|220px|The Imperial Lieutenant notices the freighter in the ''Hauler''{{'s}} bay.]]
After the party's departure and the loading of cargo, consisting of much-needed (sabotaged) [[proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]], and for the next sixteen hours, Obota sent the ''Crow'' to some missions around the [[battle group/Legends|battle group]] in order to become accepted as part of it and its routine: picking up parts, securing rations, and a training mission which the Rebel agents used as reconnaissance of northern Ruusan. Before departing from the system, the ''Hauler'' discreetly left the ''Crow'' near the planet.<ref name="JK" />

====Ruusan and destruction====
Released in Ruusan's atmosphere, the ''Crow'', carrying Jan, Kyle and WeeGee, made a reconnaissance of the planet, flying low to avoid any detection. On their way to [[Fort Nowhere]], Kyle picked up a signal forming a [[primitive binary code]] which beaconed to a certain location, and Kyle persuaded her to follow it. The signal became stronger as they approached the Fort, ruined in a [[Battle of Fort Nowhere|recent Imperial attack]]. Failing to detect any survivors, they continued to the south for the landing zone and fifteen minutes later they landed on a flood plain between two dried riverbeds. With he weapon systems online, set for a hot start, Jan exited, holding a remote connected to the ship's sensors. [[Fido|A flyer]] came and inspected them, and then beckoned them further to the west. Jan had a hard time following the [[Flier|flyer's]] low speed, until it led them to a courtyard outside an [[Unidentified Ruusan temple|ancient temple]]; as it turned out, it was the hideout of the battle's survivors led by Sulonese [[Grif Grawley]].<ref name="JK" /><ref name="JK audio" />

For the next phase of the mission, Katarn, Grawley, a native [[Bouncer]] called [[Floater]] and Jan took the ship to an area five klicks from the [[Valley of the Jedi]]; a night move that required Jan's acute piloting skills. She landed it inside a canyon and they covered the ship with a [[CN-15 camouflage netting|camouflage netting]]. Once more, Kyle insisted that WeeGee should remain on board as Floater would guide the humans to the canyon. However their presence was reported by [[AD-43]] and felt by [[Jerec (Inquisitor)|Jerec]]. While Kyle tried to sneak into the Valley, Imperials captured Ors who remained behind, and found the ''Crow'' parked in the canyon. It was taken onboard the ''[[Sulon Star]]'', docked on the [[Valley Tower]].<ref name="JK" /> Kyle saw the ''Crow'' docked there while searching the tower, and had moments to realize that it was captured; he didn't have time to worry about Jan because he soon met Jerec and his Dark Jedi.<ref name="JK audio" />

In that confrontation, Kyle was pushed back by Jerec's [[Force destruction]] blast, thrown inside the ''Sulon Star''{{'s}} airlock. Its support systems damaged by the blast, Kyle's only option was to reach the docking port. From there, he managed to reach his ship in the docking port and escape the disaster. He activated the emergency start up and went free from the larger ship without the safety procedures. The ship gained some distance from the crashing freighter, however, the shockwave of the explosion was too strong, and the ''Crow'' broke its port wing on a rock formation, and crashed nearby.<ref name="DF2" />

She was soon replaced by the pair's new ship, the ''[[Raven's Claw]]''.<ref name="DFS 2" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Oldcrow.png|thumb|right|220px|An early design of the ''Crow''.]]
In early production of the game, the ship was named simply ''Crow'' and was intended to be a [[Baudo-class star yacht|''Baudo''-class star yacht]]. Also, it was not a 3-D polygonal object, but a two-dimensional bitmap sprite rendered from different view angles.<ref name="PC Gamer">{{WebCite|url=http://www.df-21.net/articles/earlydf/pcgamer2.jpg|text=''PC Gamer'' article, October 1994|nolive=1|nobackup=1}}</ref>

In the alternate dark side ending of ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]'', the ''Moldy Crow'' was not destroyed. Instead, Kyle managed to avoid the rocks and successfully landed the ship. It was last seen right before his rematch with Yun.

Kyle Katarn's first meeting with the ''Crow'' appears in the novel ''[[Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire]]'' and its [[Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire (audio drama)|audio drama]] but the way Kyle reacts is different; whereas in the novel he is allowed to ''choose'' between a number of ships and eventually prefers the ''Crow'' over others, in the audio drama he is assigned the ''Crow'' without any option, expressing his dislike for it and saying that "it is not even a ship".

The [[Dark Forces: Jedi Knight (audio drama)|''Dark Forces: Jedi Knight'' audio drama]] differs from the game ''Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II'' and the ''[[Dark Forces: Jedi Knight]]'' novella: Katarn sees the ''Moldy Crow'' captured in a dock of the Valley Tower; the confrontation with Jerec is different, and Katarn runs directly to the ''Crow'' to flee Jerec.

The ''Moldy Crow'' was slated to appear in ''[[Star Wars: Empire at War]]''; however, it does not. It does appear in ''[[Star Wars: Empire at War: Forces of Corruption]]'' as the dropship for the hero Kyle Katarn, but only in skirmish mode.
